description:
openSUSE Tumbleweed port for RISC-V, currently only tests the JeOS EFI image.

Not gated by openQA yet, the results are mostly informational.

Triggered by [a jenkins job on an SUSE internal host maintained by okurz](http://jenkins.qa.suse.de/job/jeos-riscv-openqa/).
https://progress.opensuse.org/issues/152849 has more information.
name: openSUSE Tumbleweed RISC-V
template:
############################################################
#                         WARNING                          #
#                                                          #
#               This file is managed in GIT!               #
#  Any changes via the openQA WebUI will get overwritten!  #
#                                                          #
#    https://github.com/os-autoinst/opensuse-jobgroups     #
#       job_groups/opensuse_tumbleweed_riscv64.yaml        #
############################################################

---

defaults:
  riscv64:
    machine: riscv64
    priority: 50
products:
  opensuse-Tumbleweed-DVD-riscv64:
    distri: opensuse
    flavor: DVD
    version: Tumbleweed
  opensuse-Tumbleweed-NET-riscv64:
    distri: opensuse
    flavor: NET
    version: Tumbleweed
  opensuse-Tumbleweed-JeOS-for-RISCV-riscv64:
    distri: opensuse
    flavor: JeOS-for-RISCV
    version: Tumbleweed
scenarios:
  riscv64:
    opensuse-Tumbleweed-DVD-riscv64:
      - textmode
      - minimalx
    opensuse-Tumbleweed-NET-riscv64:
      - create_hdd_textmode
      - extra_tests_filesystem
      - containers_image:
          testsuite: extra_tests_textmode_containers
          settings:
            CONTAINER_RUNTIMES: 'docker,podman'
            K3S_INSTALL_UPSTREAM: '1'
            CONTAINERS_UNTESTED_IMAGES: '1'
            CONTAINER_IMAGE_TO_TEST: registry.opensuse.org/opensuse/factory/riscv/totest/containers/opensuse/tumbleweed
            POSTGRES_IP: 'ko.dmz-prg2.suse.org'
            POSTGRES_PORT: '5444'
    opensuse-Tumbleweed-JeOS-for-RISCV-riscv64:
      - jeos:
          settings:
            EXCLUDE_MODULES: libzypp_config
      - jeos:
          machine: riscv64_cpu_max
          settings:
            EXCLUDE_MODULES: libzypp_config
      - jeos-container_host_podman:
          settings:
            BOOT_HDD_IMAGE: '1'
            CONTAINER_RUNTIMES: 'podman'
      - jeos-container_host_docker:
          settings:
            BOOT_HDD_IMAGE: '1'
            CONTAINER_RUNTIMES: 'docker'
            EXCLUDE_MODULES: 'rootless_docker,validate_btrfs'
      - jeos-ltp-commands:
          settings:
            EXCLUDE_MODULES: libzypp_config
            LTP_TAINT_EXPECTED: '0x13801'
      - jeos-ltp-containers:
          settings:
            EXCLUDE_MODULES: libzypp_config
      - jeos-ltp-cve:
          settings:
            EXCLUDE_MODULES: libzypp_config
      - jeos-ltp-syscalls:
          settings:
            EXCLUDE_MODULES: libzypp_config
            LTP_ENV: 'TMPDIR=/var/tmp,LTP_TIMEOUT_MUL=2,LTP_RUNTIME_MUL=2'
            LTP_TAINT_EXPECTED: '0x13801'

name: openSUSE Leap 15.6 WSL
template:
############################################################
#                         WARNING                          #
#                                                          #
#               This file is managed in GIT!               #
#  Any changes via the openQA WebUI will get overwritten!  #
#                                                          #
#    https://github.com/os-autoinst/opensuse-jobgroups     #
#          job_groups/opensuse_leap_15.6_wsl.yaml          #
############################################################
---
defaults:
  x86_64:
    machine: 64bit_win
    priority: 50
products:
  opensuse-15.6-WSL-x86_64:
    distri: opensuse
    flavor: WSL
    version: '15.6'
scenarios:
  x86_64:
    opensuse-15.6-WSL-x86_64:
      - wsl-main:
          testsuite: null
          description: |
            Basic WSL test Test scope:
                1) Prepare WSL and other features in Windows
                2) Download the image
                3) Import embedded certificate from the image
                4) Load image
                5) Define users
                6) Register SUT
                7) Exit WSL
          machine: [win11_uefi]
          settings:
            YAML_SCHEDULE: 'schedule/wsl/wsl_main.yaml'
            WSL_INSTALL_FROM: 'build'
            QEMU_ENABLE_SMBD: '1'
            WSL_FIRSTBOOT: 'yast'
      - wsl2-main: &wsl2_test
          testsuite: null
          machine: [win11_uefi]
          settings: &wsl2_settings
            YAML_SCHEDULE: 'schedule/wsl/wsl_main.yaml'
            WSL_INSTALL_FROM: 'build'
            QEMU_ENABLE_SMBD: '1'
            WSL2: '1'
            QEMUCPU: 'host,kvm=off,vmx=on,hypervisor=off,hv_time,hv_relaxed,hv_vapic,hv_spinlocks=0x1fff,hv_frequencies,hv_reenlightenment,hv_vpindex,hv-synic,hv-stimer,hv-stimer-direct'
            QEMUMACHINE: 'q35,accel=whpx'
            WORKER_CLASS: 'wsl2'
            WSL_FIRSTBOOT: 'yast'
      - wsl2-install-msstore:
          <<: *wsl2_test
          description: |
            Basic WSL test Test scope:
                1) Prepare WSL and other features in Windows
                2) Install WSL image from the MS Store via CLI
          settings: &msstore_settings
            <<: *wsl2_settings
            WSL_VERSION: 'openSUSE Leap 15.6'
            WSL_INSTALL_FROM: 'msstore'
            WSL_FIRSTBOOT: 'jeos'
      # Add MSStore Legacy Scenario
      - wsl2-install-msstore_legacy:
          <<: *wsl2_test
          settings:
            <<: [*msstore_settings, *wsl2_settings]
            WSL_FIRSTBOOT: 'yast'
      - wsl2-systemd:
          <<: *wsl2_test
          description: 'Enable and test systemd in WSL'
          settings:
            <<: *wsl2_settings
            WSL_SYSTEMD: '1'

name: Development ALP Bedrock
template:
---
.default_settings: &default_settings
  DESKTOP: 'textmode'
  YAML_SCHEDULE: schedule/alp/alp_yast.yaml  

.image_settings: &image_settings
  <<: *default_settings
  BOOT_HDD_IMAGE: '1'
  HDD_2: 'ignition.qcow2'
  NUMDISKS: '2'
  HDDSIZEGB_1: '30'
  ENABLE_SELINUX: '1'

.selfinstall_settings: &selfinstall_settings
  <<: *default_settings
  SELFINSTALL: '1'
  NUMDISKS: '2'
  HDD_2: 'ignition.qcow2'  # openQA will create a qcow2 on the fly
  HDDSIZEGB_1: '30'

.selfinstall_settings_x86_64: &selfinstall_settings_x86_64
  <<: *selfinstall_settings
  QEMU_VIRTIO_RNG: '1'
  QEMUVGA: 'virtio'

.containers_host_podman: &containers_host_podman
  REGISTRY: '3.71.98.16:5000'
  CONTAINER_RUNTIME: podman

.networking: &networking
  EXTRA: 'networking'

.publish_hdd: &publish_hdd
  PUBLISH_HDD_1: '%DISTRI%-%VERSION%-%ARCH%-%BUILD%-%DESKTOP%@%MACHINE%.qcow2'

.install_ltp: &install_ltp
  BOOT_HDD_IMAGE: '1'
  DESKTOP: 'textmode'
  GRUB_PARAM: 'debug_pagealloc=on;ima_policy=tcb'
  HDD_2: 'ignition.qcow2'
  NUMDISKS: '2'
  HDDSIZEGB_1: '30'
  INSTALL_LTP: 'from_repo'
  LTP_ENV: 'LVM_DIR=/var/tmp/'
  PUBLISH_HDD_1: '%DISTRI%-%VERSION%-%ARCH%-%BUILD%-%FLAVOR%@%MACHINE%-with-ltp.qcow2'
  QEMUCPUS: '4'
  QEMURAM: '4096'
  QA_HEAD_REPO: 'http://download.opensuse.org/repositories/benchmark:/ltp:/stable/ALP/'
  LTP_PKG: 'ltp-stable'
  KERNEL_BASE: '1'

.ltp: &ltp
  BOOT_HDD_IMAGE: '1'
  DESKTOP: 'textmode'
  +HDD_1: '%DISTRI%-%VERSION%-%ARCH%-%BUILD%-%FLAVOR%@%MACHINE%-with-ltp.qcow2'
  QEMUCPUS: '2'
  LTP_KNOWN_ISSUES: 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openSUSE/kernel-qe/main/ltp_known_issues.yaml'
  START_AFTER_TEST: 'install_ltp'
  KERNEL_BASE: '1'

.ltp_cve: &ltp_cve
  LTP_COMMAND_FILE: 'cve'

.ltp_syscalls: &ltp_syscalls
  LTP_COMMAND_FILE: 'syscalls'
  LTP_COMMAND_EXCLUDE: '_16$|^(move_pages|msg(ctl|get|rcv|snd|stress)|sem(ctl|get|op|snd)|shm(at|ctl|dt|get))'

.ltp_sched: &ltp_sched
  LTP_COMMAND_FILE: 'sched'

.ltp_containers: &ltp_containers
  LTP_COMMAND_FILE: 'containers'

.selinux_settings: &selinux_settings
  ENABLE_SELINUX: '1'
  EXTRA: 'selinux'

.yast: &yast
  <<: *default_settings
  DUMMY: ''


defaults:
  x86_64:
    machine: uefi
    priority: 50
  aarch64:
    machine: aarch64
    priority: 50

products:
  alp-bedrock-0.1-Default-x86_64:
    distri: alp
    flavor: Default
    version: 'bedrock-0.1'
  alp-bedrock-0.1-Default-qcow-x86_64:
    distri: alp
    flavor: Default-qcow
    version: 'bedrock-0.1'
  alp-bedrock-0.1-Default-SelfInstall-x86_64:
    distri: alp
    flavor: Default-SelfInstall
    version: 'bedrock-0.1'
  alp-bedrock-0.1-Default-encrypted-x86_64:
    distri: alp
    flavor: Default-encrypted
    version: 'bedrock-0.1'
  alp-bedrock-0.1-Default-aarch64:
    distri: alp
    flavor: Default
    version: 'bedrock-0.1'

scenarios:
  x86_64:
    alp-bedrock-0.1-Default-x86_64:
      - alp_default_1:
          machine: [64bit, uefi]
          settings:
            <<: [*image_settings, *publish_hdd]
          testsuite: null
      - containers_1:
          testsuite: null
          settings:
            <<: [*image_settings, *containers_host_podman]
      - networking_1:
          testsuite: null
          settings:
            <<: [*image_settings, *networking]
      - install_ltp_1:
          settings:
            <<: *install_ltp
          testsuite: null
      - ltp_cve_1:
          settings:
            <<: [*ltp, *ltp_cve]
          testsuite: null
      - ltp_syscalls_1:
          settings:
            <<: [*ltp, *ltp_syscalls]
          testsuite: null
      - ltp_sched_1:
          settings:
            <<: [*ltp, *ltp_sched]
          testsuite: null
      - ltp_containers_1:
          settings:
            <<: [*ltp, *ltp_containers]
          testsuite: null
      - selinux_1:
          settings:
            <<: [*image_settings, *selinux_settings]
          testsuite: null

      - container_selinux_1:
          settings:
            <<: *image_settings
            YAML_SCHEDULE: 'schedule/security/container_selinux.yaml'
          testsuite: null
      - yast_1:
          testsuite: null
          settings:
            <<: [*yast, *image_settings, *publish_hdd]

    alp-bedrock-0.1-Default-qcow-x86_64:
      - alp_default_1:
          machine: [64bit, uefi]
          settings:
            <<: [*image_settings, *publish_hdd]
          testsuite: null
      - containers_1:
          testsuite: null
          settings:
            <<: [*image_settings, *containers_host_podman]
      - yast_1:
          testsuite: null
          settings:
            <<: *yast
    alp-bedrock-0.1-Default-SelfInstall-x86_64:
      - alp_default_1:
          settings:
            <<: *selfinstall_settings
          testsuite: null
      - yast_1:
          testsuite: null
          settings:
            <<: *yast
    alp-bedrock-0.1-Default-encrypted-x86_64:
      - alp_default_1:
          settings:
            <<: *image_settings
          testsuite: null
      - yast_1:
          testsuite: null
          settings:
            <<: *yast

  aarch64:
    alp-bedrock-0.1-Default-aarch64:
      - alp_default_1:
          settings:
            <<: [*image_settings, *publish_hdd]
          testsuite: null
      - containers_1:
          testsuite: null
          settings:
            <<: [*image_settings, *containers_host_podman]
      - networking_1:
          testsuite: null
          settings:
            <<: [*image_settings, *networking]
      - install_ltp_1:
          settings:
            <<: *install_ltp
          testsuite: null
      - ltp_cve_1:
          settings:
            <<: [*ltp, *ltp_cve]
          testsuite: null
      - ltp_syscalls_1:
          settings:
            <<: [*ltp, *ltp_syscalls]
          testsuite: null
      - ltp_sched_1:
          settings:
            <<: [*ltp, *ltp_sched]
          testsuite: null
      - ltp_containers_1:
          settings:
            <<: [*ltp, *ltp_containers]
          testsuite: null
      - selinux_1:
          settings:
            <<: [*image_settings, *selinux_settings]
          testsuite: null
      - container_selinux_1:
          settings:
            <<: *image_settings
            YAML_SCHEDULE: 'schedule/security/container_selinux.yaml'
          testsuite: null
      - yast_1:
          testsuite: null
          settings:
            <<: *yast
